sections.h: Flying on from Honolulu within the United States
p: A flight from Honolulu to another US airport, such as Los Angeles, is a domestic leg. Under US law, {{cab.us}}. In practice a domestic leg is flown by a US operator, or planned so that it stays within the rules; our cabotage guide explains why.

sections.h: How we plan a private flight to or from Honolulu
p: Tell us where you are flying from or to, when, and how many people are travelling. Flights to Hawaii from Asia and the Pacific are long over water, so we look at the aircraft's range and any fuel stop first, find aircraft from licensed operators, and check each operator before you see a quote. Any aircraft, any route, upon availability.

Airport rules change at short notice. The operator and its handling agent confirm the current rules for your flight before departure; every fact on this page shows its official source and the date we checked it.
